task_description: Integrate Firebase Firestore into the React mind-mapping app so that all data currently stored in localStorage is also persisted to Cloud Firestore. The app auto-saves to Firestore on changes (debounced at 2500ms) and loads from Firestore on app start, with localStorage as a fast cache/offline fallback.

verification.summary: npm run build succeeds cleanly (exit 0). No test framework exists in this project. No Dockerfile present. The implementation adds 3 new files (firebase.js, firestoreService.js) and ~19 lines to App.jsx. All existing localStorage logic is preserved intact.
